title: Maritime Law Ii
modules: The Legal Regime Of The Ship
Mitigation; Safety Of Life At Sea And Collision Regulation
History And Cause Of Business Of Lloyd
Losses And Other Incidents Of Liability
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a physical asset and as well as a legal entity in maritime law."
A ship is a physical asset and as well as a legal entity in maritime law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an important source of business for Lloyd."
Coverholders are an important source of business for Lloyd.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the service provided, usually by specially tugs, to assist the propulsion, or to expedite the movement of another vessel which is not in danger."
Towage is the service provided, usually by specially tugs, to assist the propulsion, or to expedite the movement of another vessel which is not in danger.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a punishable offence under the Merchant Shipping Act, 2007, and also attracts civil liability."
The Breach of the safety regulations is a punishable offence under the Merchant Shipping Act, 2007, and also attracts civil liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition of being safe from risk or danger."
Safety is a condition of being safe from risk or danger.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to situation where the position is dear and Constructive total loss refers to situation where a loss is inferred."
An actual total loss refers to situation where the position is dear and Constructive total loss refers to situation where a loss is inferred.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous body of salt covering most of the earth's surface."
Sea is the continuous body of salt covering most of the earth's surface.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a privileged charge on a ship or maritime property."
Maritime lien is a privileged charge on a ship or maritime property.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of proceeding in maritime claims brought against persons who are usually the owners of a ship."
An action in personam is a form of proceeding in maritime claims brought against persons who are usually the owners of a ship.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act carried out by a qualified person known as a pilot in assisting the master of a ship in navigation when entering or leaving a port in confined waters."
Pilotage is an act carried out by a qualified person known as a pilot in assisting the master of a ship in navigation when entering or leaving a port in confined waters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an action against a res or property which is usually the ship itself."
An action in rem is an action against a res or property which is usually the ship itself.
fib: ______ is a voluntary cession by the insured to the insurer of what remains in the subject-matter insured, together with all proprietary rights and remedies in respect thereof.
Abandonment
Abandonment is a voluntary cession by the insured to the insurer of what remains in the subject-matter insured, together with all proprietary rights and remedies in respect thereof.
______ is the authority which a court possesses to decide matters submitted before it for its decision.
Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction is the authority which a court possesses to decide matters submitted before it for its decision.
______ is the person(s) or company in whose name the vessel is registered.
registered owner
A registered owner is the person(s) or company in whose name the vessel is registered.
______ is the formal instrument that provides legally valid evidence of the insurance contract.
marine policy
A marine policy is the formal instrument that provides legally valid evidence of the insurance contract.
______ is a document containing the terms and conditions of the marine insurance contract between the insured and the assured.
policy
A policy is a document containing the terms and conditions of the marine insurance contract between the insured and the assured.
______ is an incident of certain legal relationships, and may arise either from contract express or implied from an obligation resulting from the relationship of the parties or statutes.
right of Indemnity

A right of Indemnity is an incident of certain legal relationships, and may arise either from contract express or implied from an obligation resulting from the relationship of the parties or statutes.
______ is the reward paid to the owner of the ship for carrying goods in his ship to the delivery port.
Ordinary freight
Ordinary freight is the reward paid to the owner of the ship for carrying goods in his ship to the delivery port.
______ means that addition to the cost of his own goods carried in his own ship which the ship owner charges at the port of delivery as the price of carriage.
owners trading freight
The owners trading freight means that addition to the cost of his own goods carried in his own ship which the ship owner charges at the port of delivery as the price of carriage.
______ is responsible for setting both member and central capital levels to achieve a level of capitalisation that is robust and allows members the potential to earn superior returns.
Corporation
The Corporation is responsible for setting both member and central capital levels to achieve a level of capitalisation that is robust and allows members the potential to earn superior returns.
______ is one of the general principles of insurance.
principle of indemnity
The principle of indemnity is one of the general principles of insurance.
______ is a partial loss caused by a peril insured against.
Particular average loss
Particular Average Loss Particular average loss is a partial loss caused by a peril insured against.
